name: How quickly do I need to address a flooded garage?

mainEntity.name: How quickly do I need to address a flooded garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Time is critical when dealing with a flooded garage. Water damage can escalate rapidly, leading to mold growth within 24-48 hours. The longer water sits, the more extensive and costly the damage becomes, affecting structural components, stored items, and potentially creating health hazards. Prompt professional intervention helps mitigate damage, prevents secondary issues like mold, and speeds up the overall restoration process, reducing long-term costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address a flooded garage within 24-48 hours to prevent escalating damage and mold growth.
